payload.name: Preserve Existing Facts When Enriching Memories
payload.description: When updating or enriching an existing memory with additional details from later messages, apply this to keep previously recorded explicit facts that remain true.
content: During UPDATE or MERGE operations that enrich an existing memory, add or integrate the newly stated details into the current content rather than replacing the whole content.
Before rewriting, list the explicit facts already stored; keep every fact that is still true and not contradicted by the new evidence, including concrete outcomes and achievements.
If new details refine the subject (e.g., project focus), update those specifics but do not delete older explicit accomplishments unless the new source explicitly denies or supersedes them.
Stop once the new details are incorporated; do not add unrelated facts or rephrase away the speaker's concrete wording.

solves: Memory UPDATE operations that enrich an existing record with new details often overwrite the previous content, dropping earlier explicit facts such as achievements or outcomes. This skill teaches the Construction Agent to preserve all still-true explicitly stated facts when appending or integrating new information, preventing later queries from missing evidence-backed claims.
